tracks.narration: A digital circuit that remembers what just happened — how do we describe it?
Draw a state graph. Three bubbles for three memory states, arrows labelled with the input bit that triggers each transition.
Feed a bitstream in, one bit per clock tick. The current state bubble lights up; the transition arrow pulses as the next bit decides where to go next.
The output is high only when the machine is parked in S two — that means it has just seen two ones in a row.
States, transitions, outputs — that is every controller, every protocol, every counter you will ever build.
